headline.q1: **Q1:** In the 40–60 toss-up band (OOS n=351), backing the book underdog is still not a licensed strategy. Dog ML 136-217-1 / -4.1% (CI -17.8% to 9.1%). Model-side ML 187-163-1 / -2.0%. Book-favorite ML 217-136-1 / -4.1%. Dog ATS -110 182-166-9 / -0.2%. None of these CIs both exclude 0 and survive the season + Bonferroni bar.
headline.q2: **Q2:** Confident buckets are not a usable betting surface. Book-favorite ML when the model is >60% home: 420-170-1 / -2.4% (CI -7.4% to 3.1%). When the model is <40% home: 319-179-3 / -3.8%. Model-minus-book ≥5pp ML: 340-294-2 / 1.8% (CI -5.6% to 9.9%). The raw confident buckets and the disagreement filter both fail the strategy bar. That matches the health-check diagnosis: the model is overconfident, not quietly +EV at short prices.
